title: Essential Flavors – Ice Shot 30ML
description:
Essential Flavors – Ice Shot 30ML
Looking to add some menthol to your vape juice? Ice shot allows you to transform any e-liquid into a tasty icy feeling, or apply to already mentholated juices to intensify the experience.
Note: This product is not a ready-made e-liquid. This product is intended to be mixed with other vape juices to turn them into menthol vape juice. Add the amount of Ice Shot in your vape juice in accordance with how intense menthol flavour you want.
Primary Flavours
: Menthol
Bottle Size
: 30ml
